_method_note: ROBUSTNESS, NOT a fair judgement. temp 0.3 with presence_penalty 0.0 is OUTSIDE 3.8's recommended no-think settings. Documents degeneration behaviour off-spec.
_lane_note: Tower2-local lane on :18105; no SSH tunnel and no launcher (lane is managed manually).
_arm_note: Arm 1 no-think, arm 2 thinking. Qwen3.6's template has no reasoning_effort (binary enable_thinking only), so its think arm carries no effort key; Qwen3.8's think arm uses xhigh, its DEFAULT. 3.6-think vs 3.8-think-xhigh is therefore default-vs-default.
_effort_ladder_note: Qwen3.8 effort ladder: xhigh (default) / medium / low. 'high' is an alias for xhigh (verified byte-identical at seed 42) and is NOT run as a separate cell. Only xhigh and low inject reasoning_instructions; medium injects none, making it the no-steer control rather than a midpoint. All three arms share one sampling point so the effort token is the only variable. Qwen3.6 has no reasoning_effort at all, so these arms have no 3.6 counterpart and map 3.8's internal ladder only.
_arm_order_note: nothink is FIRST deliberately. Arms run sequentially within a lap and xhigh costs ~47k completion tokens/cell, so a trailing nothink arm was being starved of replicates - the exact arm the 3.6-vs-3.8 question depends on. Order is throughput policy only and does not affect the configuration of any cell.
_parked_note: Think arms parked to concentrate both 3.8 lanes on the no-think arm, which is the load-bearing comparison against Qwen3.6 and was running at a ~4:1 denominator disadvantage. The effort-ladder question is already answered (xhigh/medium/low all have 24-32 cells). Parked arms are preserved verbatim in _parked_arms and every think cell already on disk is untouched. Restore with park_think_arms.py --restore.
